_comment: DERIVED FIXTURE, do not hand-edit. knowledge-fixture.json with both SegmentFusionService OCR
filters applied: carriesMeaning() drops unlabelled-digit lines (the chart price axis), and
chromeOcrLines() drops lines present in >=60% of the video's windows (ratio 0.6, minWindows 4).
Exists so scripts/eval-knowledge-prompt.py can measure the filters as an input-side change,
MEASURED RESULT: filtering makes no difference to rule recovery. 13.8 of 19 against 14.8
unfiltered, four interleaved reps each, which is inside the harness's +/-3-rule noise floor.
The filters are kept in SegmentFusionService for the 17% token saving, not for accuracy.
Kept here so that negative result stays reproducible rather than being re-litigated.
179s), fetched verbatim from GET /videos/{id}/multimodal-timeline. They are checked in rather
than fetched so the eval is reproducible without a populated database, and so a change in the
FUSE phase cannot silently move the baseline underneath a prompt comparison.
facts[] is a hand-listed ground truth: every rule the transcript states. Scoring is keyword
based and deliberately generous - a group hits when all of its terms appear anywhere in the
run's units, so a paraphrase counts. It measures whether the RULE survived extraction, not
noise[] counts units that should not have been emitted at all.
